ideas.title: Glassblowing at a beach furnace
ideas.goal: the player gathers molten glass on a pipe from Lumi's furnace and shapes it by feel: blow (hold space) to inflate, spin the pipe to keep it round or stop spinning to let it slump sideways, tip it down for a neck, swing it to stretch it; it stiffens as it cools, thin walls first, so every piece is a race and a crooked one is really crooked. Finished pieces stand on the cottage window shelf and throw caustics; a friend can be given one and keeps it at home
ideas.idea: No morphing mesh: the gather is a full 3D triangle shell simulated as a discrete viscous sheet (Batty, Uribe, Audoly, Grinspun 2012: a shell whose rest shape creeps towards its current shape at a rate set by viscosity, so it flows instead of springing back), built on PrintSim's sheet solver on Mantle. Per vertex: wall thickness (volume kept as it stretches) and temperature, cooling by radiation and convection faster where the wall is thin, viscosity from the Vogel-Fulcher-Tammann law (a thousandfold from orange to set). Forces: breath pressure inside, gravity in the pipe's rotating frame, centrifugal from the spin. A thin side sets while a thick side still sags, which is how real pieces go crooked. In the tracer it glows by its temperature (blackbody emission) and ends as dielectric glass with refraction. Watching: an orange blob swelling unevenly on a turning pipe, dimming to clear, a lopsided vase throwing light on the sill.
ideas.form: new place on the island (furnace, pipe, shelf assets), a jump-in interaction and a GPU shell solver; a traced film of one piece from gather to shelf

ideas.title: Ants: draw a honey trail, then they take over
ideas.goal: the player drags a honey-dipped stick across the meadow to draw the ants a road to the friends' picnic biscuit; the colony follows, shortens the road on its own, and dozens of ants pull the big biscuit home together. The player blocks, bridges and races them (can they get the biscuit in before the friends eat it?), and luring the trail right through the pigs' bed is the joke
ideas.idea: A thousand leaf-cutter-size ants on the GPU laying and following pheromone on a field that diffuses and evaporates (stigmergy), so the trail straightens and re-routes by itself; each ant carrying a crumb or pulling on the biscuit adds a force, and the biscuit moves as a rigid body under their summed pull with ground friction (real cooperative transport: a few pull wrong, the biscuit rotates and stalls). Readable: every ant carries a pale crumb, the trail is a moving dotted line, and the biscuit is the size of a friend's head. Watching: a line forming, the biscuit jerking forward and turning at the stick.
ideas.form: plugin with a GPU kernel, instanced ant mesh and a generated biscuit asset; traced close-up film of the biscuit going home round an obstacle

ideas.title: Swing on vines through the pine wood
ideas.goal: the player shoots a vine at any branch the crosshair finds and swings: let go at the bottom to fly, catch the next branch before the ground, chain swings across the wood without touching the grass; momentum is everything, so a good release feels great and a bad one drops them in the ferns
ideas.idea: The hook finds real branches by Raycore rays against the trees' own meshes (the climb_edges lip finder already does this); the vine is a verlet rope with stretch, Lumi a body with mass on it, so the swing is a real pendulum with energy kept, the vine slackens on the way up, and a release launches a real ballistic flight with air drag. Watching: Lumi arcing through the trees, the vine bending, a long flight and a catch.
ideas.form: jump-in move with a rope mesh; traced film following one chain of three swings
